name: HexWartz
constraints: Preserve information sections, intro, navigation and interactive behavior; the venue may expand into a cinematic scroll sequence
No full-screen canvas or WebGL for the ambient background
decisions: Refine the existing wizarding identity with midnight ink, antique gold, sparse enchanted dust and transparent Great Hall candles
Retain the existing transparent character and crest artwork
Use static fine-line crest rings and softer button glows
Use a native-scroll three-scene journey with gentle image zooms, crossfades and accessible chapter buttons
Distinguish the imagined castle from the real daytime campus, and add a subdued Great Hall backdrop to the house section
Give the house, codex and prize headings matching transparent hat, spellbook and goblet illustrations with reserved space and no added motion
Preserve the user-preferred flying owl-post letter and visible label throughout scrolling; do not dock or hide it during visual refinements
The user rejected the moonlit castle image: keep it out of the page and hero; retain the campus day/night journey and flying letter
Use a crisp transparent parchment image for Enter without blur, glow or floating motion; responsive menus and card grids must fit phone, tablet, laptop and landscape screens
